_doc: Cross-investor rulings for the YC run (COLLECTION.md §12). `distinct`: pairs that share a name key but are different companies, so invariant 10 never compares them. Adjudicated 2026-09-07 over the 47 pairs YC's verify surfaced. YC collides with the rest of the dataset more than any other investor — 1,031 shared name keys across 14 landed bases — and 37 of the 47 disagreements were not disagreements at all, just one-word collisions. Merged at read time by verify; the shared file is written only at wave alignment. Second adjudication 2026-09-07 over the 80 pairs remaining after the base was corrected: 59 distinct, 21 same. Distinct was decided by era, sector or domain — Menlo's 1998 Amplitude Software against Nasdaq AMPL, Greylock's 1984 Index Technology against index.io, Battery's 1997 Cruise Technologies against GM's Cruise.
